resources.string: Make a one-time purchase to export PDF and CSV reports together in one ZIP file.

Premium purchase and restore use your Amazon account. To verify ownership, Refundavio sends only your Amazon user ID and Premium receipt ID to its verification server, which checks them with Amazon. Your Refundavio records stay on your device.
